segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I pulled up the quote we sent on Friday. It was for 42 seats, annual term starting March 1, and the services package for onboarding.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, I have it. The seat count is right for launch. We may add six or eight more in Q3, but finance wants the initial PO to match the 42.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Totally. We can keep the quote at 42 and note that additional seats are prorated at the same unit price through the first term. That way you don't need a new contract for a small add-on.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that's helpful. The other question was invoicing. Can you invoice 50% on signature and 50% on July 1? Our budget resets then.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, I checked with billing this morning. For the software, they can split it that way. The onboarding fee is due on signature, so that would be $6,500 upfront, then the remaining software balance on July 1.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Got it. And the total on the order form was $38,220, before tax, correct?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct. That's $31,720 for the platform and $6,500 for onboarding. Taxes would show on the invoice based on your billing address in Ohio.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Legal had one small redline on the auto-renewal notice period. They want 60 days instead of 45.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That should be fine. I'll run it through deal desk just so it's documented, but that's a standard change for us. I can send the updated order form and terms by end of day.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. If we can get that today, I can route it for signature tomorrow. We're trying to keep the April 15 go-live.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Makes sense. Once we have signature, I'll introduce your admin team to our implementation lead. We'd target kickoff the week of March 11, which keeps April 15 very doable.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Send it over to me and copy Marcus in procurement. I'll watch for it.
